user.title: Freebox address
user.description: Address of your Freebox Server. For the first setup, use the local address (mafreebox.freebox.fr): the app authorization is only possible from the local network.

link.title: Authorize on the Freebox Server
link.description:
Click Submit, then within a minute press the right arrow on the Freebox Server screen to authorize « Home Assistant - Freebox PVR ».

Then, in Freebox OS > Freebox settings > Access management > Applications, give this app the TV recording (PVR) permission and click Submit again.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Freebox. Check the address and port.
error.register_failed: Authorization refused or not confirmed in time on the Freebox Server screen.
error.permission_missing: The app is authorized but lacks the TV recording (PVR) permission. Grant it in Freebox OS then submit again.

data_description.notify_services: When the guide lists a different program on the slot of a weekly repeat, a notification with Cancel / Keep buttons is sent to these devices (always also shown in Home Assistant).
